rationale: git_sentinel_commit invokes unrestricted git commit on the existing index, so unrelated already-staged changes are included. Its caller later performs unrestricted amend. _git suppresses signing and returns stdout without checking returncode; the stale added script path may fail while subsequent commit still consumes existing staged content. Source-level Git integrity risk; no git mutation was executed.

source_checks.observation: Git helper disables signing and ignores returncode.
Commit has no path restriction or clean-index guard; add uses scripts/c5_exergy_optimizer_monitor.py.
Dirty state is printed but does not block mutation.
Main unconditionally commits, stages STATUS and amends, then prints completion.
